name: Urza
description: Urza is a master artificer and planeswalker born on Dominaria, brother of Mishra and creator of Karn, who waged the Brothers' War and a long vendetta against Phyrexia.

description_citations.text: "Urza". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Urza is a master artificer and planeswalker born on Dominaria, brother of Mishra and creator of Karn, who waged the Brothers' War and a long vendetta against Phyrexia.

citations.text: "Urza". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Urza and Mishra, brothers born on Dominaria, waged a savage war that devastated the plane and plunged it into an ice age.

citations.text: "Dominaria". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: He built his tower as a workshop, created Karn, taught Teferi at Tolaria and trained Tawnos as his apprentice, while his wife Kayla later said she was glad he was gone.

bio.text: At the end of the war he discovered the dark plane of Phyrexia.

citations.text: "Dominaria". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: He detonated the sylex on Argoth by pouring everything into it, and Teferi spoke to him in the void of the blast as he was remade into a planeswalker.

"Urza". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

status.text: He is dead, having perished together with Yawgmoth, though Teferi later has a dreamlike conversation with him beyond time in which he says their time is up.

citations.text: "Urza". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian black mana corrupts Serra's Realm, drives away Serra, and leads to Radiant's coup; Urza evacuates some angels to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Urza was able to evacuate some of the angels to Dominaria

citation.text: "Angel", section "Serra angels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The peace summit collapses; the Qadir stabs the Yotian Warlord, Urza's automaton chokes the Qadir, and Mishra's Weakstone overloads the automaton.
timeline.quote: The Qadir drew his saber and stabbed the warlord in the chest, killing him.

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At a second summit Mishra convinces Kayla to steal Urza's Mightstone; Urza reclaims it and declares war, starting the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: This was the start of the Brothers' War.

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra attacks Kroog, left undefended by Urza's absence.
timeline.quote: allowing Mishra to launch an all-out attack on its capital

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra, with their master Tocasia, explore the sacred cave of Koilos; Urza falls behind in the Hall of Tagsin and finds the Mightstone.
timeline.quote: Urza fell behind in the Hall of Tagsin, where he discovered the remarkable Mightstone.

citation.text: Mightstone (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As children, Tocasia takes the brothers to Koilos, where Mishra discovers the weakstone.
timeline.quote: Mishra discovered the mysterious weakstone.

citation.text: Weakstone (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza gives amulets to the healers of Kroog as a sign of friendship, drawing thousands to the city.
timeline.quote: Urza gave the healers of the city potent amulets

citation.text: Amulet of Kroog (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kroog is destroyed while most of its defenders are at Urza's side, and Urza vows that his allies will never need to fear for their defense again.
timeline.quote: After Kroog was destroyed while most of its defenders were at his side, Urza vowed that none of his allies would ever need to fear for their own defense again

citation.text: Yotian Soldier (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tawnos creates clay warriors; Urza promotes him from apprentice to master.
timeline.quote: Urza ended his apprenticeship, promoting him directly to the rank of master.

citation.text: Clay Statue (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The war between Urza and Mishra makes Dominia itself a casualty of war.
timeline.quote: the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominia itself a casualty of war

citation.text: Strip Mine (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra discover a stone in the Caves of Koilos; disturbed, it splits into Mightstone and Weakstone and unleashes Phyrexia's evil on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: unleashing the evil of Phyrexia on Dominaria

citation.text: "Antiquities", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Brothers' War erupts between Urza and Mishra for control of both halves of the stone, with ancient Thran machines used in battle.
timeline.quote: an epic war between Urza and Mishra for control of both halves of the stone

citation.text: "Antiquities", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Two orphans from Argive, Urza and Mishra, are brought to Tocasia's school and spend years learning the secrets of the Thran.
timeline.quote: They live for many years at the school, learning the secrets of the Thran.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 1". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The brothers fly Tocasia in the ornithopter, crash near the Caves of Koilos and find two powerstones; each craves both and they begin to mistrust each other.
timeline.quote: Urza takes the Mightstone , and Mishra the Weakstone .

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 1". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The brothers' contest ends in an explosion that kills Tocasia and many others, and they split ways.
timeline.quote: Their confrontation ends in an explosion, that kills Tocasia and many others.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza wins the contest in Kroog with an artificial warrior to marry Kayla.
timeline.quote: Urza's constructs an artificial warrior that he uses to win the contest

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Korlis conference the king of Kroog attacks Mishra's forces with ornithopters; open conflict erupts; Ashnod kills Urza's patron, and Urza's Mightstone bests Mishra, who flees cursing Urza and his house.
timeline.quote: Fleeing, Mishra curses Urza and his house.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza pursues the Fallaji with ornithopters into the Western Desert and is lured deeper into the sands.
timeline.quote: Urza's troops are lured even further into the unforgiving sandy landscape.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 4". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Brothers' War spreads across Yotia and the Great Desert, and Mishra is changed by his experience in Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Mishra's experience in Phyrexia seems to have changed him.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 4". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Peace Summit at Korlinda the Qadir kills the Warlord of Kroog, and Ashnod weakens Urza's automaton to free the Qadir before the Fallaji flee.
timeline.quote: Ashnod used her Staff of Zegon to weaken it, forcing it to release the Qadir.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle at Argoth Ashnod passes the sylex to Tawnos and holds off Gix while Urza activates it.
timeline.quote: Ashnod passed the sylex to Tawnos , who conveyed it to Urza while she held off the Phyrexian demon.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sylex Blast destroys both armies and Argoth.
timeline.quote: The ensuing Sylex Blast destroyed both armies and the island of Argoth.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When their father falls ill, Urza and Mishra are sent to study at Tocasia's archaeological dig.
timeline.quote: he sent them away to his old friend, Tocasia

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Caves of Koilos the brothers find the powerstone sealing Phyrexia and break it in two while each grabs for it.
timeline.quote: they broke it in two

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The brothers' rivalry over the halves causes a falling-out and Tocasia's accidental death.
timeline.quote: the inadvertent death of Tocasia

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Yotia Urza builds a huge machine to move a jade statue, wins the contest and weds Kayla bin-Kroog to gain a Thran tome.
timeline.quote: He succeeded and was wed to Kayla bin-Kroog

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Double-crossings and sneak attacks between the brothers escalate into open war.
timeline.quote: soon resulting in open war

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Fall of Kroog, Urza's avengers are outclassed by Mishra's dragon engines.
timeline.quote: Urza's avengers were completely outclassed by Mishra's dragon engines

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix infiltrates both sides, leading to the Fall of Terisia City.
timeline.quote: both sides became infiltrated by a group of fanatical, machine-worshipping priests called the Brotherhood of Gix

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Last Battle at Argoth the brothers meet at the head of their armies and Urza finds Mishra corrupted by Phyrexian influence.
timeline.quote: Urza discovered there that Mishra had been corrupted by Phyrexian influence

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza unleashes the Golgothian Sylex, slaughtering both armies and sinking Argoth, which ignites his planeswalker spark.
timeline.quote: It slaughtered both armies, blasted the landscape for miles, sank the sub-continent of Argoth

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The blast ignites Urza's spark, giving him his first brief planeswalk.
timeline.quote: caused the ignition of Urza's planeswalker spark

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza says a final farewell to Tawnos and leaves Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Urza departed Dominaria after saying a final farewell to his student and good friend Tawnos

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The brothers destroy the college and many of its sages.
timeline.quote: the school itself was destroyed by the Brothers at some point during the war

citation.text: "College of Lat-Nam", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex on Argoth, ending the Brothers' War and sending Dominaria into an Ice Age.
timeline.quote: Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex on a completely ravaged Argoth.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sardian dwarves, found to be trading with Mishra too, rise against Argive and are slaughtered.
timeline.quote: they eventually rose against Argive, and for this, they were slaughtered

citation.text: "Dwarf", section "Sardian Dwarves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Harbin is helped by an Argothian elf and tells Urza of the island.
timeline.quote: When, millennia later, Harbin stumbled upon Argoth, he was helped by an Argothian elf.

citation.text: "Elf", section "Terisiaran Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex and destroys Argoth and its elves.
timeline.quote: ultimately they were all destroyed when Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex

citation.text: "Elf", section "Terisiaran Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After their parents' deaths, the brothers Urza and Mishra come to an archeological school, where their tale begins.
timeline.quote: Following the deaths of their parents, the two brothers came to one of the archeological schools.

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Introduction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the contest between the brothers Tocasia is killed and her school is probably destroyed; each keeps one stone.
timeline.quote: As a result of the contest, Tocasia was killed and her school was most likely destroyed.

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 1: The Story of Urza and Mishra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza, under the patronage of the King of Kroog, develops a guild-like structure of apprentices.
timeline.quote: Urza, under the patronage of the King of Kroog, developed something akin to a guild structure

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 1: The Story of Urza and Mishra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The trading conference at Korliss ends in an attack that provokes the brothers' struggle into open conflict.
timeline.quote: It provoked the brothers' struggle into open conflict.

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 1: The Story of Urza and Mishra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The brothers struggle together against a Phyrexian demon, the black heart, in the desert.
timeline.quote: it is believed that the brothers struggled with a Phyrexian demon that might have entered Terisiare through the gateway in the cave of Koilos

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 2: The Urza-Mishra War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gix manipulates both brothers, fails to kill Mishra because of the Weakstone, and oversees Mishra's Compleation.
timeline.quote: he oversaw Mishra's Compleation, bringing the younger brother fully into Phyrexia's grasp

citation.text: "Gix", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gix lures both brothers to Argoth, starting the Battle at Argoth.
timeline.quote: He also lured both brothers to Argoth

citation.text: "Gix", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza's sylex blast wipes out both armies and forces Gix back to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: forcing Gix to escape back to Phyrexia with a handful of human followers

citation.text: "Gix", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza creates golems animated with the word EMETH while dueling Gerrard in Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: he created several golems that he brought to life by inscribing them with the word EMETH

citation.text: "Golem", section "Thran Golems". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle at Argoth Ashnod passes the Sylex to Tawnos, who conveys it and its detonation process to Urza.
timeline.quote: Ashnod passed the sylex to Tawnos , who conveyed it and its detonation process to Urza.

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Discovery and use". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In remorse, Urza performs the Sylex's ritual with his blood, grief and pain and activates it.
timeline.quote: He spoke the words of the inscription, and the sylex activated.

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Discovery and use". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sylex Blast destroys both armies and Argoth, begins the Ice Age and ignites Urza's spark.
timeline.quote: Caught at the epicenter of the blast, Urza's spark ignited.

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Discovery and use". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza wins Kayla's hand by having his automaton move a great statue.
timeline.quote: Urza's automaton succeeded

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Life with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Kayla grow close after her father's death.
timeline.quote: the couple grew closer

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Life with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra convinces Kayla to steal Urza's Mightstone and sleep with him; Urza discovers them, reclaims the stone and declares war.
timeline.quote: he convinced Kayla to steal Urza's Mightstone and sleep with him

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Life with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza visits Loran disguised as a grieving widow.
timeline.quote: Urza appeared to Loran in the guise of a grieving widow.

citation.text: "Loran", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra uncover the stones in the Hall of Tagsin, each taking one, which reactivates the gate to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Urza took the Mightstone and Mishra the Weakstone, unwittingly reactivating the gate to Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The jealous brothers use the stones against each other and accidentally kill Tocasia, then separate.
timeline.quote: accidentally killing Tocasia when she tried to calm them

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza finds Kayla with Mishra, negotiations collapse and war is declared; Ashnod kills the Qadir and Mishra ascends as Qadir.
timeline.quote: Mishra would then ascend as Qadir and leader of the Fallaji.

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "Opposing sides of war". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra and Urza are born; years later their father dies after sending them to apprentice with Tocasia.
timeline.quote: they remained with her

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tocasia, Urza and Mishra fly to the Thran city Koilos, find a great machine, and an explosion leaves each brother holding half of the powerstone.
timeline.quote: each brother was holding a half of the great stone in their hand

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Apprenticeship to Tocasia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra confronts Urza while drunk and tries to take his stone; Tocasia is killed caught between the stones' powers and Mishra flees.
timeline.quote: she was caught between the powers surging from the two stones and died

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Apprenticeship to Tocasia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra seduces Kayla into stealing Urza's Mightstone at the Kroog peace talks; Urza reclaims it and Mishra flees.
timeline.quote: he convinced Kayla to sleep with him and steal Urza's Mightstone

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Serving the Qadirs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Argoth Urza reveals Mishra as a construct of flesh and Phyrexian metal and destroys him and the forest; Urza ascends as a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Urza released an enormous burst of power that destroyed both Mishra and the sentient forest

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Death and afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During Apocalypse Urza meets a tormented body of Mishra deep in Phyrexia, whose nature is uncertain.
timeline.quote: he met the body of Mishra deep in the Center of Phyrexia

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Death and afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza's Sylex Blast damages the plane and the sentient forest of Yavimaya traps Multani in its rift.
timeline.quote: instead causing Multani to become trapped in the rift.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Yavimayan rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians track Urza to the realm, taint it, and Serra abandons it, entrusting Radiant.
timeline.quote: entrusting the archangel Radiant as its caretaker in her absence

citation.text: "Serra", section "Collapse of Serra's Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza saves refugees and collapses the plane into the Weatherlight's powerstone.
timeline.quote: saved many Serran refugees before collapsing the plane

citation.text: "Serra", section "Radiant and the end of the Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza returns with the Weatherlight, rescues thousands of refugees and collapses the plane into the ship's powerstone core.
timeline.quote: rescuing thousands of Serran refugees before finally collapsing the plane into the ship's powerstone core

citation.text: "Serra's Realm", section "Collapse of Serra's Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza settles on Shiv by making peace with Gherridarigaaz and persuading goblins to work with viashino; the Rig produces powerstones for his Legacy.
timeline.quote: managed to settle with the viashino living by the Rig by making peace with the dragon Gherridarigaaz

citation.text: "Shiv", section "Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tawnos travels to Kroog and lures Urza from his work with a snake toy, becoming his apprentice.
timeline.quote: He successfully dragged the Chief Artificer away from his work at the Yotian laboratory by presenting him with a self-made snake toy.

citation.text: "Tawnos", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After creating clay warrior golems, Tawnos is promoted from apprentice to master.
timeline.quote: Urza promoted him directly from apprentice to master.

citation.text: "Tawnos", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tawnos survives the Sylex Blast sealed in the Stasis Coffin and remains there five years until Urza releases him.
timeline.quote: He remained there for 5 years until the ascended Urza released him.

citation.text: "Tawnos", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Argoth is obliterated when Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex in the last battle.
timeline.quote: Completely obliterated in the last battle of the War, when Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex .

citation.text: "Terisiare", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tocasia takes Urza and Mishra, about sixteen, on a pilgrimage to the Caves of Koilos where they find the Mightstone and Weakstone.
timeline.quote: Urza discovered the Mightstone, and Mishra, the Weakstone.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the pilgrimage the brothers grow apart, becoming jealous of Tocasia's attention and guarding their secrets.
timeline.quote: They became increasingly jealous of Tocasia’s attention.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Both brothers court Ashnod and suffer a final cataclysmic quarrel, parting forever.
timeline.quote: they had a final cataclysmic quarrel and parted ways forever.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tocasia dies, removing the brothers' last restraining influence, and the battle is joined in earnest.
timeline.quote: Shortly thereafter, Tocasia died, ridding the brothers of their final restraining influence.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza allies with Kroog and spreads influence over Yotia while Mishra works the west and Zegon, where Ashnod joins him as a harsh overlord.
